acceptanceCriteria: The HLQ failure for a missing repository-data envelope includes the additionalContext text it received, so a visible fallback degradation is distinguishable from a malformed envelope.
The cause of the intermittent upgrade-case failure is identified and either fixed or recorded with its host-load bound in the HLQ spec.
Three consecutive claude-code HLQ runs at load averages above 80 each pass or name their cause in the report.
body:
On 2026-09-27 the HLQ-V1 claude-code tuple (Claude Code 2.1.267, adapter 0.2.3, darwin/arm64) on Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 154 (fc594fa6) passed 8 of 9 cases. Case upgrade failed with "SessionStart: additionalContext carries no repository-data envelope" at load averages 81-109 on 12 CPUs. A rerun of the same tuple and binary, with a harness copy that prints the received text, passed 9 of 9 at load 97-125, so the failing text was not captured. An earlier run at 54e0c517 showed "Corvint FALLBACK degraded: adapter-host-kill-deadline" on PostToolUse (cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:118), which suggests SessionStart hit the adapter host-kill deadline under load and emitted the visible fallback instead of an envelope. conformance/host-lifecycle-v1/main.go:947 reports the failure without the text it received.

2026-09-28 reviewed local outcome: Local diagnostic fix 79b2ef0e is independently reviewed on codex/host-lifecycle-fix; CEM c08f110ac670061c01fe32e04d4407db55612758. Four selected keyed checks and strict dogfood check PASS. Three consecutive real Claude qualifications passed 9/9 each; start/end load samples were above 80. Raw results are committed in conformance/host-lifecycle-v1/results/2026-09-28-hlq-diagnostics. Continuous load was NOT_OBSERVED. Historical discarded-response cause remains UNKNOWN; watchdog degradation is a hypothesis. Integration verified: PR #321 merged at 798d815261764837b1f271fc97646f180ca221ec, reviewed head 1542bc602a5236d334610038fa541b00005c58e4 is on origin/main, and all 11 CI checks PASS. Remaining: criterion 2 root-cause qualification; the discarded historical response cannot be reconstructed. Ticket remains OPEN.
title: HLQ claude-code upgrade case intermittently gets no repository-data envelope from SessionStart under host load
